gaps.explanation: Every column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p7) is covered: the Nonmajor Governmental Funds column 24,873,318 equals the 16 nonmajor fund lines from the combining schedules (pp20-21) exactly. The gap is in the three major funds, whose detail comes from the Budget and Actual - Budgetary Basis schedules: General Fund GAAP 150,093,422 (p7/p19) vs budgetary 147,532,941 (p12) = 2,560,481 = 'Revenue accruals' 2,560,481 printed in the budgetary-to-GAAP reconciliation (p14); Highway Fund GAAP 12,930,742 vs budgetary 12,882,200 (p15) = 48,542 (p16 revenue accruals 97,643 include the 49,101 sale of capital assets); Federal Grants Fund GAAP 17,027,410 vs budgetary 5,579,803 (p17) = 11,447,607 (p18 revenue accruals 11,447,676 include the 70 sale of capital assets less 1 transfer rounding). 2,560,481 + 48,542 + 11,447,607 = 14,056,630 = gap. No fix.

Nonmajor column 29,672,960 (p7) equals the 16 nonmajor fund lines (pp20-21). Major funds from the budgetary-basis schedules: General Fund budgetary 136,040,798 (p13) + Veterans Aid 13,049 (p22) + Broadband 62,572 (p23) = 136,116,419 vs GAAP 136,326,740 (p7/p19): schedule 210,321 short (expenditure accruals (792,488) + current year encumbrances 580,121 on p14, and Veterans Aid 13,049 budgetary vs 11,003 GAAP); Highway budgetary 23,195,137 (p15) vs GAAP 22,244,537: 950,600 above (expenditure accruals (5,833,481) + encumbrances 6,784,081, p16); Federal Grants budgetary 15,453,406 (p17) vs GAAP 14,558,297: 895,109 above (= expenditure accruals 895,109, p18). -210,321 + 950,600 + 895,109 = 1,635,388 = schedule above statement. No fix.

Statement transfers in 21,131,803 (p8). Detail: General 1,720,646 (p14), Highway 7,769,005 (p15), Federal Grants 126,677 (p18, budgetary; GAAP 126,676 p8), Veterans Aid 20,000 (p22), Broadband 100,000 (p23), nonmajor 11,515,476 (pp20-21) = 21,251,804. The 120,000 Veterans Aid/Broadband transfers in are eliminated inside the General Fund on the combining schedule (p19 Elimination (120,000)), so the statement does not show them; plus 1 budgetary rounding on Federal Grants. 120,000 + 1 = 120,001. Gross-per-fund recording only. No fix.

Statement transfers out 21,131,803 (p8). Detail: General (17,391,239) from the budget schedule (p14) + Federal Grants (1,039,474) (p18) + nonmajor Keno (1,455,789), Gaming Tax (1,151,000), Law Enforcement Equipment (214,301) (pp20-21) = 21,251,803. The General Fund column on the statement prints (17,271,239) because the 120,000 transferred to the Veterans Aid and Broadband subfunds is eliminated (p19: General Fund (17,391,239), Elimination 120,000, Total General (17,271,239)). Difference 120,000 = elimination only. No fix.
